# Step - both_e

`both_e` · `bothE` · category: [Walking the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#walking-the-graph)

Moves to the incident edges in both directions, optionally only edges with the given labels.

## Forms

```text
both_e()
both_e(arg1: any)
both_e(arg1: array)
both_e(arg1: any, arg2: any)
both_e(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(4).both_e().label().to_list()   // ["knows", "created", "created"]
```
